# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.10

## Added

- Door unlock and staircase-light buttons at the bottom right of the card.

## Fixed

- Keep card sensors and call controls on the selected camera's device without
  falling back to another doorstation when its assignment is unavailable.
- Keep reconnect-expiry and entity-registry callbacks on the Home Assistant
  event loop, preventing Repairs thread-safety warnings after a failed event
  registration.
- Identify the failing registration stage in connection-error warnings without
  adding device traffic.
- Confirm queued ringer changes from device events and readback instead of
  rejecting a temporarily unchanged device value. No repeated device writes or
  background polling are added.
- Show ringer command failures as normal Home Assistant errors instead of
  unexpected WebSocket exceptions.

## Upgrade

- Includes native agent 1.9.10. Update the agent for the ringer confirmation fix.
  The event-loop callback fix does not depend on an agent update.
